 Chris Hemsworth wraps up weeks of filming in Thailand for ‘Extraction 3’
 By Khaosod English - 28 October 2026, 12:22 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LINE 
 WhatsApp 
 Pinterest 
 ReddIt 
 VK 
 Hollywood star Chris Hemsworth is wrapping up his time in Thailand after several busy weeks filming Extraction 3, while making time for adventures away from the set.
 In an Instagram post shared on 28 October 2026, the actor said he was finishing his stay in Thailand after what he described as “crazy few weeks” of filming.
 Advertisement 
 Despite his demanding work schedule, Hemsworth said he had managed to fill his weekends with fun, non-work adventures.
 Advertisement 
 The post offered a glimpse into the actor’s time in Thailand as production on the third instalment of the Extraction action film series continues.
